test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - Reasoning(Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Param drives 8 km towards north from point A. He takes a right turn and drives 8 km. Again he takes a right turn and drives 4 km. Finally, he takes a right turn and drives 8 km to reach point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?
solution:
Param starts from point A and drives 8 km towards the North.

He then turns right and drives 8 km.

Again, he turns right and derives 4 km.

Finally, he turns right and derives 8 km.

And reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b69ef2ace7689da193e31772181e8cbe3f17db502666ec03284691d9c190125.png] 

So, point A is 4 KM in the South from point B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
